$comment: Mutation gate modules. `mutate` entries are compiled dist files (the core tests import ../dist): a path mutates the whole file, {file, functions} only those functions/methods. Each mutant runs `testFiles` in order and is killed by the first failing file. Scores ratchet in mutation-baseline.json. See doc/MUTATION_TESTING.md.

bot-policy.description: bot tool allowlist validation and policy warnings (bots/bot-policy.ts)

bot-permission.description: agent/session allowlist intersection (turn/resolve-turn-tools.ts) and bot session permission defaults (bots/bot-facade.ts)

model-fallback-chain.description: model fallback chain settings, validation and planning (model/fallback-chain.ts)

memory-namespace.description: bot memory namespace isolation (memory/bot-memory-scope.ts + agent_id filters in memory/store.ts)

skill-proposal-validate.description: skill proposal validation and secret detection (skill-proposals/validate.ts)

message-agent.description: inter-agent messaging relay, owner checks and wake rules (tools/message-agent.ts)
